title: Community categories
description: The topic a member picks when posting. Situations, never diagnoses — a list of conditions would ask a person to diagnose themselves before they are allowed to speak. Seeded into community_categories by scripts/db/migrate.mjs; there is no second copy in code.

categories.description: Array order is display order. Must contain a catch-all so nobody is stuck at the first screen because their life does not fit a box.

id.description: Stable key. Referenced by community_posts.category_id, so renaming one orphans existing posts.

blurb.description: One line under the label. Written to a person choosing where to put something difficult, not as marketing.

active.description: False retires a category from the picker without orphaning the posts already filed under it.
